messages.content: What parameters do the viscous friction force depend on, and in which case should it be taken into account for the physical pendulum model? In your response the last word of each sentence must become the first word of the next sentence.

message.content:
Viscous friction depends on the velocity of the object.
This force also relies on the viscosity of the fluid.
The model requires this term when air resistance is significant.
Significant drag occurs at high speeds or in dense media.
Media like water create substantial resistive forces.
Forces from these sources alter the period of oscillation.
Oscillation changes can be measured experimentally.
Experimental data helps determine the damping coefficient.
Coefficient values allow for accurate simulation.
Simulation results match real-world observations closely.
